description:
The Columbia and Western Rail Trail (CWR)is a historic rail line that passes through many communities across BC from Christina Lake to Midway.

The trail narrows at KM 157 restricting motorized vehicles to those 1.5m wide or smaller. Signage is on site requiring larger vehicles to turn around.
directions: Access to the trail is possible from the many communities that the rail trail passes through. There are many access points where the trail crosses industry logging roads. Be mindfull of those sections of the trail with both motorized and non motorized use.

stats.Activity Details: Viewing, Mountain Biking, Horseback Riding, Hiking
